items.title: Statement on the directive to suspend Fable 5 access
items.summary: The US government has issued an export control directive suspending all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by foreign nationals inside or outside the US.

items.title: TCS brings Claude to regulated industries
items.summary: TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 employees across 56 countries, build Claude-powered products for regulated industries, and join our partner network.
